spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(updated_at, $__interval),
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'succeeded') AS succeeded,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS failed
FROM jobs
WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND status IN ('succeeded', 'failed')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Jobs that reached a final status in each interval (by updated_at).
spec.title: Jobs completed per interval

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, $__interval),
  count(*) AS created
FROM jobs
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Jobs submitted in each interval (by created_at).
spec.title: Jobs created per interval
